svg.aria-label: Bit-width ladder aligned on the binary point, from 16-bit inputs to the 44-bit reduction accumulator and back to a 36-bit prediction.
svg.title: Fixed-point width ladder at default parameters
svg.text: MATRIX_RESULT_WIDTH = 2·16+2 = 34 · PREDICTION_WIDTH = 36 · accumulator = 44 · shift = F + RW − 1 = 11 · solid = sign bit, dashed = discarded
